# /project-review — Comprehensive production-grade project review and assessment. Systematically analyzes code quality, architecture, security, UX, performance, documentation, and feature completeness. Produces structured findings with a prioritized roadmap organized into implementation waves.

## When to Use

Invoke this command when the user requests or implies the
`project-review` operation.

## Purpose

Comprehensive production-grade project review and assessment. Systematically analyzes code quality, architecture, security, UX, performance, documentation, and feature completeness. Produces structured findings with a prioritized roadmap organized into implementation waves.

## Shared State

This command participates in the shared workflow state. Read and update:

- **AGENT_BACKLOG.md** — Prioritized work items; read before starting, update when adding/completing tasks
- **.windsurf/state/orchestrator.json** — Phase, team status, metrics; read for context
- **.windsurf/state/events.log** — Append a log line when completing significant actions

| `--focus` | Focus area: all, security, performance, ux, docs, architecture | all     |
